metas.name: Bosko, the Talk-Ink Kid
metas.description: A cartoonist draws Bosko, who promptly comes to life.

metas.name: Sinkin' in the Bathtub
metas.description: The music-happy Bosko and Honey take a car ride, but bad luck briefly interrupts their fun.

metas.name: Congo Jazz
metas.description: Bosko hunts in the jungle, but ends up playing music with the animals.

metas.name: Hold Anything
metas.description: Bosko is a construction worker who impresses Honey by making music from everything in sight, including a decapitated mouse, a typewriter and a goat filled with hot air.

metas.name: The Booze Hangs High
metas.description: Bosko has a grand time on the farm, dancing with a cow, playing a horse's tail like a violin and getting drunk with three pigs.

metas.name: Box Car Blues
metas.description: Bosko and his porcine friend are hobos in a runaway boxcar.

metas.name: Big Man from the North
metas.description: Bosko is a Mountie in the cold, snowy north. His sergeant demands that he get his man: a peg-legged villain wanted dead or alive.

metas.name: Ain't Nature Grand!
metas.description: Bosko fishes, and sings and dances with frogs. But two ladybugs use a wasp as an airplane, and a beehive and tree branch as a machine gun to drive him away.

metas.name: Ups 'n Downs
metas.description: Bosko runs a hot dog stand at an amusement park; but Bosko sneaks away to the racetrack to ride his mechanical horse.

metas.name: Dumb Patrol
metas.description: During the Great War, Bosko and a fearsome beast are in a dogfight. Bosko loses, but that's only the first battle.

metas.name: Yodeling Yokels
metas.description: Bosko and Honey yodel happily in the Alps until a series of disasters end with Honey rushing downriver on an ice floe.

metas.name: Bosko's Holiday
metas.description: Bosko and Honey go on a picnic that ends badly.

metas.name: The Tree's Knees
metas.description: Bosko the woodsman spurns cutting down trees and plays music instead. The trees and animals dance and make their own music.

metas.name: Lady, Play Your Mandolin!
metas.description: Things are hopping at a certain Mexican cafe and then Foxy walks in and the customers go really wild.

metas.name: Smile, Darn Ya, Smile!
metas.description: A streetcar conductor, Foxy has adventures with a would-be passenger hippo, a cow blocking the tracks, and a runaway train while Foxy, his passengers, and some hobos sing the title song.

metas.name: Bosko Shipwrecked!
metas.description: Bosko is shipwrecked on an island where he is chased by a lion and pursued by simian cannibals.

metas.name: One More Time
metas.description: Foxy the Cop is trying to enforce the law in town, but dangerous drivers and strangers who also kidnap Roxy are making this difficult.

metas.name: Bosko the Doughboy
metas.description: Bosko is a doughboy in the Great War. Bullets and bombs are everywhere. (A bomb even blows up the title card.) Bosko and his fellow infantrymen are hardly safe in their trench. Bosko is happily eating from a pan full of beans when a bomb hits the pan and destroys his meal. Bosko misses Honey; he pul

metas.name: You Don't Know What You're Doin'!
metas.description: Piggy picks up his girlfriend and takes her to a theater where a hot jazz orchestra is playing.

metas.name: Bosko's Soda Fountain
metas.description: Bosko is a soda jerk, who gives poor service to a mouse and to his former schoolteacher. Later, he must contend with Honey's bratty Wilbur.

metas.name: Hittin' the Trail for Hallelujah Land
metas.description: Piggy and Fluffy have adventures on a riverboat and Uncle Tom is chased by skeletons promising to take him to Hallelujah Land.

metas.name: Bosko's Fox Hunt
metas.description: Bosko joins a wacky fox hunt. But if the hunt worries anyone, it isn't the fox.

metas.name: Red-Headed Baby
metas.description: The old toymaker goes to sleep, and his toys immediately come to life and sing "Red-Headed Baby." A red-haired baby doll begins the song. She's soon joined by her sweetheart, a toy soldier named Napoleon. A spider briefly spoils the fun when he descends upon the toys and grabs the doll. It's up to N

metas.name: Bosko at the Zoo
metas.description: Bosko and Honey go to the zoo. Honey is frightened by the lion, but Bosko is the one who ends up in danger.

metas.name: Pagan Moon
metas.description: On a tropical island, a native boy sings "Pagan Moon" to his sweetheart. Later, he plays music underwater with an octopus-pianist and other jazz-loving sea life.

metas.name: Battling Bosko
metas.description: Bosko is a brave little boxer who battles the champion, Gas House Harry. The enormous brute proves a bit much, even for a plucky underdog. Some of the animation is later reused in "Bosko's Parlor Pranks" by M.G.M. in 1934.

metas.name: Freddy the Freshman
metas.description: Freddy comes to a party and is a hit; he then goes on to be the star quarterback at the football game.

metas.name: Big-Hearted Bosko
metas.description: While ice-skating on a frozen pond, Bosko and his dog discover a baby abandoned in the snow.

metas.name: Crosby, Columbo, and Vallee
metas.description: An American Indian boy and girl sing and dance in the forest along with the animals. Trouble begins when a fire threatens baby birds in their nest.

metas.name: Bosko's Party
metas.description: Bosko whistles "It Ain't Gonna Rain No Mo" as he walks down the sidewalk in the pouring rain. His umbrella provides a good sailboat when he wants to cross a flooded street. Meanwhile, Honey is getting dressed and made up. She's about to remove her nightgown when she realizes that we in the audience

metas.name: Goopy Geer
metas.description: Goopy, a dog of no particular personality, but a crackerjack piano player, plays several songs on the stage of a nightclub. We spend a fair amount of time watching the patrons and staff of the nightclub.

metas.name: Bosko and Bruno
metas.description: Bosko and Bruno escape from a speeding train via a handcar; make a failed attempt to steal a chicken; and end up on a runaway boxcar.

metas.name: It's Got Me Again!
metas.description: Late at night, the mice come out and sing and play to the title tune, among others. That is, until the cat arrives, but he's quickly sent packing.

metas.name: Moonlight for Two
metas.description: Two courting hillbilly dogs, which is Goopy Geer and his girlfriend, go to the big barn dance. Then a villian comes over to try to shoot him with a gun, then fights, and the villian got on fire and escaped thanks to the walking stove.

metas.name: Bosko's Dog Race
metas.description: Bosko enters his dog, Bruno, in a dog race.

metas.name: The Queen Was in the Parlor
metas.description: The last Goopy Geer cartoon. The king returns to his castle, and asks where the queen is; she's in the parlor, and won't be seen, according to the title song. He goes to his throne and summons his jester, Goopy Geer. A black knight arrives and threatens one of the young ladies in court; Goopy Geer f

metas.name: Bosko at the Beach
metas.description: Bosko, Honey, and Bruno spend a day at the beach.

metas.name: I Love a Parade
metas.description: A circus parade, to the title tune. Next, a series of sideshow acts: the wild boy, the rubber man, siamese twin pigs, a tattooed man, a hula-dancing hippo, an Indian snake (or goat) charmer. Into the ring, we have a hippo riding a horse (much to the horse's dismay), a high-wire act (again, to the ti

metas.name: Bosko's Store
metas.description: Shopkeeper Bosko takes care of business.

metas.name: Bosko the Lumberjack
metas.description: Bosko and his friends are cutting down trees in a forest. He battles a burly woodsman named Pierre who has gone off and kidnapped his beloved Honey.

metas.name: You're Too Careless with Your Kisses!
metas.description: A bee returns home late after a night out having too much honey. His wife leaves him, but quickly ends up in the clutches of an evil large predator.

metas.name: Ride Him, Bosko
metas.description: Ride Him, Bosko! is a western-flavored cartoon with lots of shooting gags involving body reduction, and card characters singing! There's also an alcohol gag that has a really strong one turning a male piano player into a woman instantly!

metas.name: I Wish I Had Wings
metas.description: An expectant father rooster fetches doctor stork, who comes out with a basket full of white chicks and one little black one, who gets crowded out of the food. After singing the title song, he manages to improvise a pair of wings and fly over the chicken coop, but regrets it when he is chased by a me

metas.name: Bosko the Drawback
metas.description: Bosko is the star player in a wacky game of professional football.

metas.name: A Great Big Bunch of You
metas.description: A mannequin in the city dump improvises a working piano from junk, then plays and sings the title song. Various discarded items join in with song or dance.

metas.name: Bosko's Dizzy Date
metas.description: Honey is trying to teach the violin to Wilbur, the one who hates music. Honey calls Bosko over. Bosko and Honey sing, dance, and play music while Wilbur continues to express its disdain.

metas.name: Bosko and Honey
metas.description: This is an unreleased cartoon that eventually went on to have most of its animation recycled by Bosko's Dizzy Date. Honey is trying to teach the violin to Wilbur, the one who hates music. Honey calls Bosko over. Bosko and Honey sing, dance, and play music while Wilbur continues to express its disdai

metas.name: Three's a Crowd
metas.description: An old man is reading a book by the fire. The clock strikes 8, and he heads off to bed. From his book, Alice in Wonderland, out crawls Alice, who turns the radio to the title tune. This wakes up Rip Van Winkle; Alice then rouses the Three Musketeers, who sing a bit. Next tune: Nero fiddles, Rome bur

metas.name: Bosko's Woodland Daze
metas.description: While romping through the forest, Bosko falls asleep and dreams of giants and gnomes.

metas.name: The Shanty Where Santy Claus Lives
metas.description: Christmas Eve. A poor orphan boy trudges through the snow, pathetically. He finally arrives at his miserable cabin. While he is crying, Santa arrives and, singing the title song, offers to take the boy to his workshop. They arrive, and the toys go wild. He plays with a few toys. A candle falls off t

metas.name: Bosko in Dutch
metas.description: Set on a frozen pond in Holland, various animals attempt to skate on the slippery ice.

metas.name: One Step Ahead of My Shadow
metas.description: Several Chinese residents play music. A dragon frees himself from a cage and goes after them, but fireworks are shoved down the dragon's throat. This causes him to explode and turn into a walking dragon skeleton.

metas.name: Young and Healthy
metas.description: A king is bored with the stupid people in his court. He goes out in search of young people.

metas.name: Bosko the Speed King
metas.description: Bosko enters a road race.

metas.name: The Organ Grinder
metas.description: A beloved Italian organ grinder plays his music and sings his song through an immigrant-filled ghetto neighborhood, where hard-scrabble kids and well-proportioned matrons get hep to the beat that flows from the organ grinder's calliope. There are lots of spoofs of life on the Lower East Side and lot

metas.name: Bosko in Person
metas.description: Bosko and Honey perform a wacky stage act that includes doing imitations of Maurice Chevalier, Greta Garbo and Jimmy Durante.

metas.name: Wake Up the Gypsy in Me
metas.description: A camp of Russian gypsies, dancing and playing music. After an opening dance, a quartet of beer-drinkers gargles the Volga Boatman song, then another group hauling on a rope sings it (we finally see that the other end of the rope is anchored by a very small dog). A trench-coated bomber sneaks into t

metas.name: Bosko's Knight-Mare
metas.description: Bosko, after reading a book about medieval knighthood, falls asleep and has a nightmare where Honey, his girlfriend, in the role of a princess, gets captured. Bosko finds the villain, and wakes up in the midst of fighting him and destroys his knight replica.

metas.name: I Like Mountain Music
metas.description: After hours, individuals on various magazine covers in a drugstore come to life and sing, speak, or perform. Caricature celebrity depictions include George Arliss, Eddie Cantor, Sonja Henie, Benito Mussolini, Ignacy Paderewski, Edward G. Robinson, Will Rogers, and Ed Wynn. A robbery sequence feature

metas.name: Bosko the Sheep-Herder
metas.description: For the first three minutes or so of this one, Bosko doesn't really have much to do and is only seen briefly playing a musical instrument. Instead, the bulk of the time is spent following a lamb and its interactions with a couple of insects.

metas.name: Beau Bosko
metas.description: Bosko is a soldier in the Foreign Legion out to capture the desert scourge, Ali Oop.

metas.name: Shuffle Off to Buffalo
metas.description: An animated singing and dancing revue of babies (representing a variety of stereotypes) who are being prepared for delivery by stork.

metas.name: The Dish Ran Away with the Spoon
metas.description: Utensils and food dance, sing, and play in the kitchen, until a lump of dough turns into a monster and they all unite to stop it.

metas.name: Bosko's Picture Show
metas.description: Bosko runs a movie theater that shows a wacky newsreel with Jack Dumpsey, a slapstick short from Haurel and Lardy, and a turn-of-the-century melodrama starring Honey.

metas.name: We're in the Money
metas.description: After the last human has left the department store, the toys proceed to the music department where they start performing the Warren/Dubin song "We're in the money". The money soon joins for a chorus, as well as display dolls in the wardrobe department.

metas.name: Bosko the Musketeer
metas.description: Bosko and Bruno go to Honey's house where she shows him a picture of the Three Musketeers. Bosko tells her a story of himself as a Musketeer and Honey as a dancing girl. He fights a villain with swords over Honey and wins. The real Honey finds the story hard to believe.

metas.name: Bosko's Mechanical Man
metas.description: Bosko creates a robot. The only problem is that his creation goes mad wreaking havoc.
